extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners and patent practitioners (attorneys/agents/applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for examination of patentability under U.S. law (MPEP Chapter 2100): subject matter eligibility, utility, written description, enablement, novelty, obviousness, claim interpretation, inventorship, prior art, and related examination procedures. Used by examiners and practitioners to formulate rejections, evaluate responses, and ensure compliance with statutes and case law.
